svg.text: On this machine: SHA-256 is 1.17× to 2.22× faster than BLAKE3; BLAKE3 is 1.56× to 3.61× faster than SHA-1DC; BLAKE3 SME2 matches BLAKE3 below 16 KiB and is up to 2.30× faster from there
Line and dot: median · shaded band: minimum–maximum across 120 interleaved samples · single-threaded · lower is better
